clusters.reason: The PR aims to fix intransitive equality near 2^63 by comparing integers and floats exactly rather than widening them, so 2^63-2 and 2^63 no longer compare equal.
The PR fixes strict weak ordering violations for mixed integer/float comparisons near 2^63, changing `<` results to reflect exact comparison.
The PR extends exact comparison to large unsigned integers and floats, preventing lossy widening conversions.
The PR updates mixed negative integer and float comparisons to be exact.
Fixing transitivity of incomparability (equivalence) near 2^63 is explicitly stated in the pull request description and issue #5401.
Using these numbers as keys in associative containers like std::map requires a valid strict weak ordering, which this PR restores by preventing lossy collisions.
Symmetric comparison operators (float vs integer) are updated alongside integer vs float to maintain consistent and exact comparisons.
Relational operator outcomes are corrected from lossy approximations to exact comparisons as requested by the PR.
